headline_seed: ‘I was fighting for my life’: Indian pilot hailed as hero recalls flydubai cockpit attack - The Guardian
draft_text:
FlyDubai captain Smit Machchhar, stabbed mid-flight by his co-pilot on a 182-person Dubai–Tel Aviv run, told PM Modi from his Abu Dhabi hospital bed: "I was fighting for my life." AP and CNN confirm the Boeing 737 diverted safely to Saudi Arabia.

And that's the mews.
